title: Flaky: Aspire.Azure.Storage.Queues.Tests ConformanceTests.TracingEnablesTheRightActivitySource(_Keyed) RemoteExecutor hangs due to Azure Identity IMDS credential probes on Windows
job_name: Tests / No-package tests (regular, Aspire.Azure.Storage.Queues.Tests, Azure.Storage.Queues, Azure.Storage... / Azure.Storage.Queues (windows-latest)
error_pattern:
Microsoft.DotNet.RemoteExecutor.RemoteExecutionException : Half-way through waiting for remote process.
   at Microsoft.DotNet.RemoteExecutor.RemoteInvokeHandle.Dispose(Boolean disposing)
   at Aspire.Azure.Storage.Queues.Tests.ConformanceTests.TracingEnablesTheRightActivitySource[_Keyed]()
Caused by: DefaultAzureCredential sequentially probing Environment/WorkloadIdentity/ManagedIdentity credentials and hanging on http://169.254.169.254 IMDS endpoint
analysis: The RemoteExecutor child process hangs while DefaultAzureCredential sequentially attempts Environment, WorkloadIdentity, and ManagedIdentity credential sources, ultimately probing the sandboxed IMDS endpoint (169.254.169.254) which is unavailable/unresponsive on the GitHub-hosted Windows runner, exceeding the RemoteExecutor wait timeout. This is an environmental/infrastructure credential-probe timing issue unrelated to the PR's Radius-only changes, and closely mirrors an existing tracked pattern for the same root cause in a different Azure conformance test suite (Azure.AI.OpenAI, issue #18920).
